notFixtures.lib/deferred-delivery.mjs: a shared helper: the deferred-chain fixtures import its waits and its exactly-one check, and it asserts nothing when the runner loads it on its own
notFixtures.lib/fixture-guard.mjs: a shared helper: the runner fixtures import its parse and typecheck refusals, and it asserts nothing when the runner loads it on its own
notFixtures.test-all.mjs: the root aggregator: it spawns every file beside it, so counting it as a pass would count the suite twice
